posts.title: What to do with my Smart Ring?
posts.description: I read Niq‘s article and I feel it. My Apple Watch died on me […] I think I’ve made my peace and don’t need another Apple Watch for the time being. And considering that I’m currently looking to rid myself of optional technology, this might be for the better.
